result.summary: One significant visual issue is visible: a restaurant card is showing a broken image placeholder instead of its intended artwork.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card contains a large empty gray image area with a broken-image icon, making the restaurant content look incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL or loading logic and provide a valid restaurant image. Add a branded fallback image rather than displaying the browser-style broken-image placeholder.

issues.description: Several horizontally scrolling items are partially cut off at the right edge, including the category chip and restaurant carousel card titles.
issues.suggestion: Confirm that the horizontal carousel is intentionally scrollable; otherwise add appropriate clipping, spacing, or responsive sizing so partial content does not appear accidental.
